## Summary

The source page (`page.html`) is a minimal JS-driven carousel fixture: raw HTML authors only 2 `<li class="slide">` items inside `<ul id="slides">`, and an inline script clones each of them (marking the clones `aria-hidden="true"`) to simulate a slick-carousel-style infinite loop, appending them so the rendered DOM shows 4 slides though only 2 are "real."

**Key decisions:**
- **Componentization**: None needed — this is a two-element page (`h1` + `ul#slides`), too small to warrant extracting reusable components. red-twine/windtailor weren't needed for componentization calls since there's only one repeated unit (`li.slide`) with no shape/purpose ambiguity.
- **JS carousel behavior**: Preserved verbatim rather than baking in the 4 slides statically, since the comment in the source explicitly documents this simulates real carousel-library (slick-carousel) behavior — cloning at runtime is the actual mechanism being tested, not an implementation detail to flatten away.
- **Styling**: Investigated with windtailor first; it reported only default browser UA styles (`h1` at 32px/700 weight, default list rendering) — no custom CSS or design tokens exist on this page. Initially added a Tailwind CDN scaffold per the standard workflow, but round 1 of the screenshot diff (0.68% pixel diff) revealed Tailwind's Preflight reset was stripping the default bold heading and bulleted/indented list styling the original relies on. Removed Tailwind entirely since there were no real tokens to express — round 2 came back at **0% pixel difference (odiff exit 0)**, a pixel-perfect match.
- **Images**: Hotlinked exactly as authored (`/product-1.jpg`, `/product-2.jpg`) — no rehosting, per scope; both render as broken-image glyphs identically in original and clone since the assets don't exist on disk, which is expected/out of scope.
- **Nothing flagged as unrecreatable** — this fixture had no canvas/video/iframe or other opaque elements.

All screenshots (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`, `clone-round2.png`, `diff1.png`, `diff2.png`) are saved in the run directory. Final clone written to the requested path: `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-1JEIkj/clone.html`.
